components.name: PreviewCard
components.summary:
Gallery-style tile built from Card, Text, and StatusBadge: a cover image,
title/description, status, tags, and caller-owned actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary human-readable title.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary description.
props.example: "Perlin-noise procedural terrain heightmap, computed in Rust via Wasm."

props.name: cover
props.type: { readonly src: string; readonly alt: string }
props.description:
Optional cover image shown above the title, clipped to the card's own
corners. `alt` is bundled with `src` so accessible text can never be
forgotten when a cover is present.

components.name: GridLayout
components.summary:
Draggable/resizable dashboard layout using Grafting-owned panel contracts.

Consumers whose bundler does not already provide it must import
`react-grid-layout/css/styles.css` once at the application level; this
package does not import it as a side effect (it declares `sideEffects:
false`), so the choice of when and whether to load that stylesheet stays
with the consuming application.

props.name: panels
props.description: Immutable caller-owned panels and their current placements.
props.example:
[{ placement: { id: "p1", x: 0, y: 0, width: 12, height: 4 }, content:
Panel
}]

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the grid region.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns the grid is divided into.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of one grid row in CSS pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between panels in CSS pixels, applied both horizontally and vertically.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Whether panels can be dragged to a new position.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Whether panels can be resized.

props.name: onPlacementsChange
props.description: Receives the complete next placement for every panel after a drag, resize, or compaction.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional caller-owned class name for layout composition.
